test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If 2744 identical small spheres are made out of a big sphere of radius 7 cm, then what is the surface area of each small sphere?
solution:
**Given:**

Big sphere radius = 7 cm

Number of small spheres = 2744

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = (4)/(3) π r³

Surface area of a sphere = 4 π r²

**Calculation:**

Volume of the big sphere = (4)/(3) π (7)³

Volume of the big sphere = (4)/(3) π (343)

Volume of the big sphere = (1372)/(3) π 

Volume of each small sphere = (1)/(2744) times (1372)/(3) π 

Volume of each small sphere = (1372 π)/(3 times 2744) 

Volume of each small sphere = (1372 π)/(8232)

Volume of each small sphere = (1 π)/(6)

Let the radius of each small sphere be r cm.

Volume of each small sphere = (4)/(3) π r³

⇒ (4)/(3) π r³ = (1)/(6) π

⇒ r³ = (1)/(8)

⇒ r = (1)/(2)

Surface area of each small sphere = 4 π r²

Surface area of each small sphere = 4 π ((1)/(2))²

Surface area of each small sphere = 4 π times (1)/(4)

Surface area of each small sphere = π cm²

**The surface area of each small sphere is π cm².**
